scientific_integrity: The hazard, positivity and source dating were checked against the publicly accessible 2023 article. Symbolic and rational sign checks support but do not replace the infinite-domain proof. No outside expert or independent validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Counts distinct zeros of the hazard derivative, not density modes. Does not characterize every parameter region of one-versus-three turns; tangencies may occur. Priority remains subject to previously unindexed related literature.
title: Three is the sharp maximum number of hazard turning points in the Chen–Perks lifetime family
